sentences.en: Leave the cave and descend the ladder, now head right and cross the bridge goin up.

sentences.en: Maids sing "Castles Are So Hard to Dust", the new monster sings "Its Alive" (all through which he imitates Elvis), while Ego sings about "Goin' Choppin" as he prepares to shop for body parts.
sentences.vi: Người giúp việc hát ""Castles Are So Hard to Dust"", con quái vật mới hát ""Its Alive"" (tất cả đều bắt chước Elvis), trong khi Ego hát về ""Goin 'Choppin"" khi anh ta chuẩn bị mua sắm các bộ phận cơ thể.

sentences.en: If so, why not cover up that not quite a six pack ab set you've got goin' on and give women a little something good to talk about?

sentences.en: Get ready for some shootin', some huntin', some horseback ridin' and some steamboat ridin' because your yellow-bellied hide ain't goin' to make it too far there.

sentences.en: Previously Condoleezza Rice Crew in Sudan security rumpus Hey George, where you goin ' with that iPod in your hand?

sentences.en: Then we 're goin ' for a slap-up meal an ' tomorrow you can go into town an ' get some new clothes.
